name: New line - iPhone Air $0.99 - Extra 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: thoughtful design student.
scripted_messages: Hi! I'm a student and I've wanted an iPhone Air forever. Your site says $0.99 a month with a new line and an eligible plan, no trade-in. Could you tell me the total monthly cost for one line with Extra 2.0, and whether the student discount applies to it?
Thanks! Which plans does the student discount work on?
Does it need some kind of verification, like a student email?
That's really helpful, thank you. You were super kind and patient, it made this so much less stressful.
Nope, that's all. Have a great day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
